posts.title: Neo-Luddism before AGI, and how we are going to live on
posts.description: This post is a rant. A thought-provoking rant, I hope so. No, I don’t mean Luddism in a pejorative sense. I am referring to the Luddite movement in England, which took place in the early 19th century.
